stem.text: $\text{SO}_3$ is manufactured from $\text{SO}_2$ and $\text{O}_2$ in the Contact process.

A.text: equilibrium yield decreases; equilibrium yield increases

B.text: equilibrium yield decreases; equilibrium yield unchanged

C.text: equilibrium yield increases; equilibrium yield unchanged
